INDIA

# Swipe India Information

Website: https://getswipe.in/?country_code=IN

BusinessName: Swipe
Country: India
BusinessType: SaaS, Invoicing, Accounting
Description: Swipe is an all-in-one GST billing and accounting software for Indian SMEs. It enables businesses to generate professional invoices, track inventory, collect online payments, file GST returns, and more — all from a single easy-to-use platform.
Currency: INR

## PricingPlans:
- Free: ₹0/month — Unlimited invoicing, unlimited customers, and invoice sharing via WhatsApp.
- Pro: ₹233/month — GST billing, inventory tracking, online payments, recurring invoices, WhatsApp invoicing, and payment reminders.
- Jet: ₹308/month — Everything in Pro + E-way bills, delivery challan, Excel import/export, custom fields, and priority support.
- Advanced: Custom Pricing — Everything in Pro + Add Custom Features, Multiple Businesses/Branches, Online Store (E-commerce), Shiprocket Integration, Multiple Users, Custom Column Linking, Import/Export/Multi-currency/SEZ, Multiple Warehouses, GST Filings, Bulk invoicing via Excel, Digital Signature (.PFX), Integrations (Tally, Shopify, Shiprocket, API, Custom Email).

## UseCases:
- GST billing for small businesses, freelancers, and service providers across India.
- Inventory and invoice management for retailers, wholesalers, and shopkeepers (hardware, electronics, pharma, etc.).
- Shopify/D2C brands syncing product catalogs and inventory while generating compliant GST invoices.
- Manufacturers managing stock, warehouses, raw materials, and B2B invoicing across locations.
- Freelancers and consultants sending professional invoices and collecting online payments from clients.
- Traders handling B2B sales, bulk invoicing, delivery challans, and multi-currency export billing.
- WhatsApp-first businesses creating and sharing invoices and payment links directly with customers.
- Accountants and CA firms managing ledgers, filing GST, and generating reports for multiple clients.
- Multi-location businesses maintaining branch-wise data with user roles and permission-based access.
- Import/export businesses generating SEZ and multi-currency invoices with support for custom charges.
- Businesses automating GST returns, e-invoicing, and integrating with tools like Tally and Shopify.

## Features:
- GST invoicing & billing
- E-way bill generation
- E-invoicing
- Online payments & reminders
- Inventory tracking
- Pricelist
- Ledger sharing
- Excel import/export
- WhatsApp invoicing
- Audit trail
- Recurring billing
- User permissions
- Tally/Shopify/API integrations
- Digital signature support
- Custom fields and columns
- Multi-branch/warehouse support

## BusinessTypes:
- Retailers (hardware, pharma, electronics)
- Traders and wholesalers
- Service providers
- D2C brands (Shopify, WhatsApp stores)
- Freelancers and consultants
- Manufacturers (B2B and B2C)

## Regulations:
- GST (Goods and Services Tax)
- E-invoicing compliance (B2B)
- E-way Bill system
- Digital signature (optional, for invoice authenticity)

## FAQs:
- Is Swipe GST compliant? → Yes, Swipe is 100% GST compliant with features for GST invoicing, returns, and e-invoicing.
- Can I create unlimited invoices? → Yes, even on the free plan, you can create unlimited invoices and add unlimited customers.
- How do I collect payments via Swipe? → You can enable online payment links on your invoices and receive payments directly from customers.
- Can I connect my Shopify or Tally account? → Yes, Shopify, Tally, and other integrations are available in higher plans like JET and Advanced.
- Does Swipe support Excel import and bulk invoicing? → Yes, Jet, and Advanced plans support bulk invoicing and data import via Excel.
- Can I share invoices on WhatsApp? → Yes, all plans support direct WhatsApp invoice sharing.
- Is my data secure? → Yes, your data is encrypted and stored securely on cloud servers.
- Are mobile apps available? → Yes, Swipe is available on Android and iOS for managing business on the go.
- Can I add multiple users? → Yes, JET and Advanced plans allow multi-user access with permission control.
- Can I manage stock/inventory with Swipe? → Yes, inventory tracking is available from the Pro plan onward.
- Do I get support for GST filing? → Yes, Advanced plan includes GST filing support along with all necessary invoice and tax reports.

Currency: AED

## Pricing
- Free: Create unlimited invoices and add unlimited customers.
- Starter: AED 49/month - Includes online payments, VAT invoicing, PDF customisation, WhatsApp sharing, reminders.
- Business: AED 99/month - Includes expense tracking, multi-user access, TRN compliance, ledger sharing, price list, inventory.

- VAT-compliant invoicing

- Service providers: Create custom PDF invoices with TRN details, share via WhatsApp, and send reminders.
- Manufacturers: Maintain stock, record expenses, and generate reports for VAT filing.
